execution_policy: Read-only specifications. Installation, import, deserialization, model download, training, compilation, evaluation, inference, and deployment each require separate authorization and an execution record.

preconditions: Isolated compatible Python environment
Network/package installation authorized
PyTorch/device build and dependency lock predeclared

outputs: installed distribution metadata and dependency lock

recipes.restart: Recreate from the accepted lock and record any platform-specific dependency change.
failure_modes: CLI and Python distribution resolve from different environments
scientific_checks: Installation proves availability only; it validates no dataset, model, prediction, or device numerics.

preconditions: train.yaml is immutable and reviewed against exact 0.3.16 arguments
Name, train/valid/test files, energy/force/stress keys, units, seeds, device, dtype, cutoff, loss, stopping, and output directories are explicit
Dataset audit proves group-disjoint validation/test/OOD roles
Compute/filesystem side effects are authorized
recipes.restart: Use the dedicated restart recipe only for the same config/data/environment lineage.
failure_modes: Final model aliases a checkpoint or prior artifact
scientific_checks: Freeze thresholds before training
Select on validation only
Report independent test/OOD and slice/tail errors
Converge cutoff, architecture, precision, data coverage, and seeds

preconditions: Latest checkpoint bytes and parent run are hash-bound
Name, config, data, split, model, loss, optimizer, dtype, device policy and environment lineage are unchanged
Output paths preserve parent evidence
recipes.restart: If a scientific/config/data field changed, create a new training plan or explicit fine-tune lineage instead of restart.
scientific_checks: Compare the first resumed metrics with the parent trace and reapply all final evaluation gates.

preconditions: test.xyz and model artifact hashes are frozen
Model loading is authorized and artifact trust is established
Species, units, dtype, device, target keys and held-out status are explicit
evaluated.xyz is a new output
recipes.restart: Rerun from immutable inputs to a new output; never append mixed model/data results.

units.stress: only when --compute_stress is requested and source convention is normalized

failure_modes: Evaluation set was used for selection
Stress requested without compatible periodic labels
scientific_checks: Compute predeclared MAE/RMSE/tail metrics independently from immutable output
Slice by chemistry/configuration and include OOD
Check force-energy consistency and device/dtype regression

preconditions: models/case.model is trusted, hash-bound, independently evaluated and licensed
case.extxyz is audited for species/cell/PBC/domain
ASE/provider/environment versions and device/dtype are recorded
recipes.restart: Inference is immutable per model/input/environment; rerun as a new record after any change.
scientific_checks: Stay inside the accepted deployment envelope and monitor extrapolation
A finite prediction is not accuracy evidence

preconditions: Isolated Python >=3.10 environment
Compatible torch>=2.2 and Lightning dependency lock
Network/package installation authorized

outputs: installed distribution metadata and dependency lock

recipes.restart: Recreate from the exact accepted lock; do not infer compatibility from import success.
scientific_checks: Installation proves no model, dataset, prediction, compiler portability, or LAMMPS readiness.

preconditions: configs/train.yaml and all Hydra-resolved settings are frozen
Dataset, splits, units, species/type map, seeds, model/loss/stopping and output root are audited
run includes train and validation roles without test-driven selection
recipes.restart: Use ++ckpt_path only under the dedicated unchanged-lineage recipe.
scientific_checks: Converge architecture/cutoff/precision/data/seeds
Freeze thresholds and report held-out/OOD slice/tail errors
Training completion is not a deployable model

preconditions: Configuration run stage includes test
Test dataset is held out and immutable
ModelFromCheckpoint or the provider-documented checkpoint selection is exact
Output directory is new

outputs: provider test metrics and bound run artifacts

recipes.restart: Rerun as a new immutable model/test/config record.

units.metrics: must be normalized to the generic evidence manifest's explicit units

scientific_checks: Independently verify required MAE/RMSE/tail/slice/OOD metrics and thresholds.

preconditions: path/to/last.ckpt is hash-bound to the parent run
The original config/data/environment are identical except an allowed max_epochs increase
Output ancestry is preserved
recipes.restart: The official workflow warns that safety is not automatically checked; any other config change creates a new plan/fine-tune lineage.
failure_modes: Provider does not detect unsafe config change
scientific_checks: Diff the resolved config and compare first post-restart metrics before accepting continuity.

preconditions: Accepted checkpoint is exact and trusted
Package output is new
Bundled code/model/data-license implications are reviewed
recipes.restart: Build a new package after any checkpoint/code/environment change; never overwrite the source checkpoint.
scientific_checks: Hash the package and re-evaluate predictions; portability is not numerical equivalence.

preconditions: model.nequip.zip is trusted and independently evaluated
Deployment-like device/compiler/PyTorch environment is recorded
C++17 toolchain is available
ASE target and output path are explicit
recipes.restart: Recompile for every target/device/toolchain/package change and create a new artifact.
scientific_checks: Regression-test energy/forces/stress against the package on accepted and OOD sets before deployment.

preconditions: Isolated Python >=3.9,<3.13 environment; current Python 3.14 is incompatible
Network/package installation authorized
PyTorch 2.4-family and dependency lock are compatible

outputs: installed v1 distribution metadata and dependency lock

recipes.restart: Recreate from the exact lock; never install v2 over a v1 environment.
scientific_checks: Framework installation proves no model availability, model license, task validity, or result.

preconditions: Exact v1 environment
Model access/download/cache and network are separately authorized
Exact model card, model artifact hash, model license and OC20 task/domain are accepted
Input ASE Atoms species/cell/PBC/domain are audited
recipes.restart: Bind the downloaded model bytes once, then rerun immutable model/input/environment pairs as new records.
scientific_checks: Validate against independent OC20-compatible reference data and application-specific OOD slices
Do not infer suitability outside the model card/domain from finite output

preconditions: Isolated Python >=3.11,<3.14 environment; current Python 3.14 is incompatible
Network/package installation authorized
PyTorch 2.8-family and dependency lock are compatible

outputs: installed v2 distribution metadata and dependency lock

recipes.restart: Recreate from the exact lock; do not mix FairChem v1 code or pretrained artifacts.
scientific_checks: Framework installation proves no UMA access, model identity/license, task validity, or prediction quality.

preconditions: Exact v2 environment
Hugging Face account/model access/token and download are separately authorized without recording the token
uma-s-1p2 model card/license/artifact identity is accepted
task_name=omat is correct for the audited inorganic-material input
Charge/spin, reference-energy convention, species/cell/PBC and deployment domain are explicit

outputs: gated model download/cache artifact when absent

recipes.restart: Bind downloaded model bytes/model card/license once; every model/task/input/environment change is a new inference lineage.

units.energy: ASE eV under the selected task/reference convention

failure_modes: Model revision changes behind a name
scientific_checks: Verify task-specific charge/spin and DFT reference conventions
Validate independent in-domain/OOD slice/tail metrics
Do not compare formation/hull energies across incompatible reference conventions
Finite inference is not deployment acceptance
